bugs.error_message: Canva answered, but without a picture or a design BrandPilot could read. Check your Canva account before trying again. (canva_unreadable)
bugs.root_cause: Canva's MCP generate-image answered isError:false with structuredContent { status: "failed", failure: { code: "quota_exceeded" } } and _meta["com.canva/aiCreditQuotaError"] ("You have exceeded your credit quota."). callTool only treated isError:true as a failure, so the answer went on as a success with no design or picture and was labelled unreadable.
bugs.fix: failureOf(result) detects status "failed" / failure / the credit-quota meta even without isError; callTool throws canva_credits (402) with Canva's words and the reset date (quota_usage.resets_at). Generate-all already stops on credits.

bugs.error_message: Uncaught TypeError in assetPreview: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'v') — clicking Slide 2/5 in Campaign Studio did nothing
bugs.root_cause: Carousel slides 2..n have no caption field (inAssets only adds a field when its text is non-empty; the caption is only on slide 1). assetPreview and assetFile read a.fields.caption.v unconditionally, so rendering a later slide threw and the old screen stayed — the click did set S.ui.aid but the view never re-drew.
bugs.fix: Guard a.fields.caption in assetPreview (shows "The post caption is on slide 1") and in assetFile (caption.txt only when a caption exists).

bugs.error_message: Adding a website showed no change for ~25 s, then a page-chooser dialog popped over an already-switched results screen; 631 facts from 4 pages
bugs.root_cause: A.scan only set SRV.scanning (a disabled button label) and a 3 s toast while the server read the page and asked the AI to choose links; the chooser was a MODAL opened at the end while discovery had already re-rendered Home. Rule extraction turned every line under a heading of a website page into a fact (menus, buttons, price tables).
bugs.fix: readTrack step tracker with a live seconds ticker replaces the add box; page chooser inline on Home/Sources; website-only filters in extract (okWeb: nav labels, short/numeric lines, per-category caps).

bugs.error_message: Edit as a new post on Part 1 showed Part 3 (series had 2 posts); caption said Part 2 but the bar showed a green check
bugs.root_cause: A draft made by sxEdit carried no link to the post it edits, so partFor treated it as the NEXT part; partNeeds only searched the caption for the exact expected line, so a line with another number passed
bugs.fix: sxEdit stores d.part + d.editOf (older drafts matched by the reused illustration); headRe/prevRe find any part line and partCap replaces a wrong one

bugs.error_message: AI suggestions card showed no border/background; its rule appeared as .studio>.aih inside @media(min-width:1101px)
bugs.root_cause: A patch inserted new CSS right before the text '.ed-side{position:sticky…' — that text was the middle of '@media(min-width:1101px){.studio>.ed-side{…}', so the new rules were swallowed by the media query and the selector prefix moved onto the new first rule
bugs.fix: Moved the .aih rules out and restored '@media(min-width:1101px){.studio>.ed-side{…}'. When inserting CSS by anchor, anchor on the START of a line or a whole rule, never mid-selector

bugs.error_message: Brand colours from the website listed #0D6EFD, #DC3545, #198754, #FFC107, #0DCAF0 … (--bs-primary in bootstrap-5.min.css, 'used 29 times in the styles') — colours the site does not use
bugs.root_cause: readStyles counted every colour in every linked style sheet, so Bootstrap's palette definitions looked like heavy use and --bs-primary passed the brand-name filter; and websiteBrand read only the FIRST 5 linked sheets — md-labs.net links 9 framework sheets (Font Awesome all.min.css, two Bootstraps, Google Fonts, toastr, owl, select2) before its own main.css, so the site's real colours were never read
bugs.fix: Framework sheets (name pattern or public CDN host) no longer count; a framework's --bs-primary/--primary only counts when changed from the framework default; Bootstrap colour classes in the markup and inline style attributes count; the site's own sheets are read first (5) plus 3 framework sheets; near-identical shades merge

bugs.error_message: Clicking ↑ / ✕ in the Brand identity panel looks like the screen refreshes
bugs.root_cause: Every action calls render(), which rebuilds the whole app's HTML; the panel (.kev, animation kevin from opacity 0) and its scrim (fade) are new elements each time, so their entrance animations replay on every click. Keeping the scroll (data-ks) alone did not stop the flash
bugs.fix: render() remembers which overlays (.kev, .kev-scrim, .ov, .modal, .ck-ov, .ck, .gp) were open before render0() and sets style.animation='none' on them afterwards; a newly opened overlay still animates

bugs.error_message: (no error) Clicking the AI scene tile in Studio → Look showed no loading and created no image
bugs.root_cause: The Look-tab tile only generates when the post has no scene picture yet (data-a=aiScene). With a picture it runs scenePick, which re-applies that same picture — when it was already applied nothing changes, so it looks broken. New options are made only in the Picture tab, and generation progress was shown only there.
bugs.fix: Tile action: no picture → aiScene; picture not applied → scenePick; already applied → sceneMore (opens the Picture tab at the scene options and focuses "3 more options"). The tile shows a spinner overlay "Creating n / 3…" whenever SRV.imgBusy is this post, and a hint line (3 options · ~30 s / Tap to use / In use · tap for new options).
